    Factorization into irreducible morphisms #

    In a ray category the nonzero morphisms are ordered by μ ≤ ν iff ν = α ≫ μ ≫ β. Below a nonzero morphism there are finitely many nonzero morphisms (axiom 3 and finite hom sets), and the order is antisymmetric because non-identity endomorphisms are nilpotent. So every nonzero non-identity morphism is a composite of irreducible ones (IsRayCategory.exists_irreducible_factorization; Gabriel–Roiter 13.6).
